steps.detail: page 'modes', rows: solo,versus,couch_2v2,horde,practice,custom_planet,lan,campaign,quit; the HUD's screen (1280.0, 800.0), window (1280, 800), A1 menus on: true, features menu_modes true menus_rail true
steps.name: the start menu opens on the list of modes (opened by the smoke: a headless run has no window)
the list of modes has a 'quit' row
a mode that is not built ('couch_2v2') cannot be started: A leaves the list on screen
the mode row 'versus' is reached with the D-pad
A opens the setup for two people
a fighter is picked with the D-pad and the two players never hold the same one
intros are off (a match that starts at once)
the row 'start' is reached with the D-pad
a match is running: the tick advances

steps.detail: p1 human true, p2 human true
steps.name: the match is of the mode: the bodies' AI flags
the match starts with the picked fighters
the match plays 600 ticks and has a result (ended by the smoke with SimDamage.ko: a result card is what is under test, not the finisher)
the match-over card opens with its rows, Quit among them
a rematch ('again', chosen with the pad) starts a new match that runs
the second match plays on for 120 ticks
P opens the pause menu, Quit among its rows (the pad's Start needs a connected pad)
'menu' goes back to the list of modes
Quit asks 'Close the game?' with Stay lit
B on the question stays: the list of modes is back and the game is still running
